seo.title: SkyLab — Private cloud platform for campuses
seo.description: SkyLab is an open-source private cloud for campuses, built on Proxmox VE: request and auto-provision VMs and containers, set up whole-class labs in one go, manage firewalls and gateways, with AI-assisted operations. Contact us for a trial at your school.
seo.imageAlt: SkyLab website: a campus and its private cloud under the night sky

contact.subject: SkyLab trial inquiry
contact.note: Want to try SkyLab at your school? Email us and we can help set it up on your campus.

hero.sub: One platform for every compute resource on campus — from request to running VM

overview.title: One platform for the whole campus

lifecycle.title: From template to running VM in minutes
lifecycle.desc: Create, snapshot, resize and reclaim — the full lifecycle lives on the platform.

workflow.title: Request, review, auto-provision
workflow.desc: Students submit a request; review, capacity checks and provisioning take over automatically.

classroom.title: A whole class, provisioned in one go
classroom.desc: Rosters, fixed timetables, multi-machine environments — identical machines for everyone.

network.title: Firewall, NAT and gateway — all visible
network.desc: Every connection in and out of campus has a topology to see and rules to manage.

ai.title: AI decides where to place and what to run
ai.desc: Placement advice scores node load; template recommendations understand course needs.
ai.recommendation: "For this course, use the Ubuntu 24.04 template with 2 vCPU / 4 GB RAM."
ai.proxyCard: OpenAI-compatible AI proxy with built-in credentials and rate limits

terminal.title: Open it — it's a real machine
terminal.desc: VNC desktops and terminals run right in the browser. Nothing to install.

console.title: Real machines in the browser
console.caption: Open a VM desktop or a container terminal right in the page.

class.title: A whole class at once
class.caption: Submit the class; every student's machines are built and monitored live.

review.title: Request, approve, provision
review.caption: Once an administrator approves, the student's machine is built automatically.

firewall.title: Networking by drag and drop
firewall.caption: Draw a line on the map and the firewall rules are written for you.

outro.title: Ready to move your lab to the cloud?
